description: Estudo de avaliação de Riscos Sísmico e de Tsunami no concelho de Oeiras 2021 is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Câmara Municipal de Oeiras. This document consists of the final report on the provision of services for the preparation of the “Study for the Assessment of Seismic and Tsunami Risks in the Municipality of Oeiras”, prepared by Socarto, Instituto Superior Técnico and Instituto de Geografia e Ordenamento do Território in the context of the public tender promoted by the ... Coverage: Câmara Municipal de Oeiras. The portal shows the English title as "Seismic and Tsunami Risk Assessment Study in the Municipality of Oeiras 2021" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Câmara Municipal de Oeiras. Its keywords include riscos, planeamento-estrategico, oeirasinterativa-oeiras-pt, defesa-e-seguranca, protecao-civil. The listing shows 2 download or service links in PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
